description: Rewrite the Home page (index.html + index.css) onto the FEAT-001 foundation. Full-width hero with dark overlay; H1 'India: A Journey Through a Thousand Stories' + supporting line + two buttons 'Explore Destinations' (→ destination.html) and 'Plan Your Journey' (→ contact.html) using RELATIVE paths (fix the 127.0.0.1:5500 buttons). Short intro paragraph. Six destination cards (Rajasthan, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, Varanasi) each linking to destination.html#<id> with accurate one-line teasers. A 'Journeys' section REPLACING the fake testimonials — clearly labelled journey ideas (Golden Triangle, Backwaters & Spice Coasts, Himalayan Trails, Spiritual Rivers) as inspirations, NOT real quotes. A closing CTA. Remove the fake phone number and all fake testimonials. Create the six local destination card SVG images.

`. Add the canonical footer (no phone number). Add `` before .

Four journey idea cards: Golden Triangle, Backwaters & Spice Coasts, Himalayan Trails, Spiritual Rivers — each a short inspiration blurb (no invented prices/dates). Clearly labelled as ideas.
Add a closing CTA section (no parallax): a forest/saffron band with a short line and a button to contact.html.

Rewrite c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/index.css for page-specific layout only (hero, intro, destination-card grid, journeys grid, CTA band). Reuse tokens/classes from styles.css; do not redeclare the palette or header/footer (those live in styles.css). Ensure the hero image does not cause horizontal overflow and buttons wrap on narrow screens.
Remove all Font Awesome <link> and <i class='fas...'> markup. Remove the hotlinked raw.githubusercontent.com logo (use the canonical header logo instead).

Set FEAT-001 status to completed is not your job; set THIS FEAT's status to completed when done and record in findings the exact destination ids used (so FEAT-003 matches) and any index.css class names later pages should reuse.
acceptance_criteria: index.html links styles.css AND index.css (styles.css first), has the inline `.js` script in <head>, a unique title + meta description, favicon link, lang='en', and a skip link as the first focusable element.
The header/footer/logo markup matches the FEAT-001 canonical block exactly; aria-current="page" is on the Home link only.
H1 is exactly 'India: A Journey Through a Thousand Stories'; the two hero buttons link to destination.html and contact.html with RELATIVE paths (no 127.0.0.1).
Six destination cards exist, each linking to destination.html#rajasthan/#kerala/#himachal-pradesh/#uttarakhand/#goa/#varanasi respectively, using LOCAL images (no hotlinks).
The fake testimonials and fake phone number are gone; a 'Journeys' section presents four journey ideas clearly labelled as inspirations (not real quotes).
All have width, height, loading='lazy' (hero is eager) and meaningful alt; the hotlinked logo is gone.
No Font Awesome CDN link remains; no external image URLs remain.
index.css contains only page-specific layout (no palette/header/footer redeclaration).
verification: `python -m http.server 8000`; open http://localhost:8000/index.html — no 404s for styles.css, index.css, site.js, assets/logo-dark.svg, assets/favicon.svg, images/hero.svg and the six destination SVGs.
Click each destination card link — it navigates to destination.html#<id> (the ids will exist after FEAT-003; a 404 on destination.html itself must NOT happen since the file already exists).
Disable JS in the browser — nav links remain visible, all content (cards, journeys) is visible, hero buttons still work.
Resize from 360px to 1920px — no horizontal scrollbar appears.
